title: Logistics Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Manage inbound and outbound shipments of pharmaceutical products, raw materials, and packaging materials. Coordinate with transporters, courier partners, warehouses, and suppliers to ensure timely deliveries. Prepare and maintain dispatch documents, invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documents . Ensure logistics activities comply with GMP, GDP, company SOPs, and applicable pharmaceutical regulations . Monitor shipment status, delivery timelines, and proof of delivery (POD) and resolve delays or discrepancies. Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, Warehouse, Purchase, and Sales teams for smooth movement of materials. Ensure proper handling and transportation of temperature-sensitive and other controlled pharmaceutical products , where applicable. Maintain accurate logistics records, stock movement reports, transporter records, and shipment tracking data . Evaluate transporter performance and help control transportation costs, freight expenses, and delivery efficiency . Investigate and report logistics-related damages, shortages, delays, temperature excursions, and customer complaints , and support corrective actions.

Key Skills: Supply Chain Management,Inventory Control,Material Requirement Planning,Dispatch,Logistics Operations,FIFO,Supply Planning,Logistics Management
